title: add-rag-agent-templates-tool-calling-examples-and-docs-site-update
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts for v0.24 - includes new agent templates, step-by-step quickstarts, and example integrations with external tools (HTTP, SQL, calendar).
description: Background: This PR bundles a set of developer-facing artifacts to make it easier for engineers to get started with RAG + agent-based workflows on Redwood. Motivation: teams keep asking for canonical RAG templates and small tool-calling examples that demonstrate safe tool invocation patterns and the recommended prompt/state management. What this PR does: - Adds three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, customer-support-multi-doc, meeting-notes-summarizer) with config files and annotated prompts. - Adds a set of tool-calling examples (http-call, sql-query, calendar-integration) in the 'examples/agents/tool-calling' folder with minimal adapters and tests. - Updates the docs site quickstarts and TOC to surface the new templates and example flows. - Adds a new quickstart page: docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md with step-by-step instructions, expected outputs, and troubleshooting tips. - Includes small SDK snippets (python/typescript) demonstrating the recommended runtime config and KV cache usage. Checklist: - [x] RAG templates added and annotated - [x] Tool-calling examples added with mocks - [x] Docs quickstart page authored and linked in TOC - [x] Unit tests for example adapters - [x] CI passes (lint/build/docs) Commits (summary): - 3 commits: initial templates and examples (asha/docs/rag-templates) - refine prompts and add test harness - docs site integration and quickstart page Changes (high level): - examples/agents/templates/{faq-bot,customer-support,meeting-notes}/template.yaml - examples/agents/tool-calling/{http-call,sql-query,calendar}/README.md + adapters/mock_adapter.py (python) and adapters/mockAdapter.ts (ts) - docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md - docs/sidebar.yaml (TOC entry) - sdk-examples/python/rag_agent_example.py and sdk-examples/ts/ragAgentExample.ts - tests/examples/test_tool_calling_adapters.py Review summary: - Diego Rivera: requested clarifications on how we surface tool capabilities in the prompt and recommended mitigation for long-running HTTP calls. Suggested adding a max-timeout example and an adapter-level retry/backoff. - Author reply (Asha): implemented adapter retry/backoff (commit 2), added example timeout note to quickstart. - Maya Chen: requested clearer guidance on KV cache invalidation when switching document sets; asked to add a short paragraph in the quickstart. - Author reply: added 'Cache invalidation' section and example code snippet. - Samir Gupta: sanity-checked examples and run the test harness locally; requested minor lint fixes. CI/Checks: - Docs build: passed - Lint: initial run failed (unused imports in TS adapter) -> fixed in commit 3 - Unit tests: all examples tests pass locally and on CI - Net result: CI green after fixes Merge notes: - Squash-and-merge after approvals - No migration or infra changes required - Linked Linear tickets updated (ENG-4821 -> authored docs; DOC-214 -> quickstart) Known limitations & follow-ups: - The SQL adapter is intentionally minimal and returns mock results; a follow-up PR is planned to add a real db adapter and secure connection examples (ENG-4899). - We should add an example demonstrating streaming tool outputs in a future PR. Testing instructions: - Run examples locally with the provided mock adapters (README in each example) - Docs site can be previewed via `yarn docs:dev` (instructions added to docs CONTRIBUTING) CI metadata: - Some flakiness in docs snapshot tests previously observed; rerun of docs build succeeded after pinned dependency update (commit 3).
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial add of templates & examples; prompt refinements + adapter retry/backoff; docs site integration + lint fixes (squash-ready).
review_thread_summary: 3 reviewers provided feedback. Major feedback items addressed: timeout/retry for HTTP calls (implemented), KV cache invalidation doc paragraph (added), lint fixes applied. Final approval from Diego, Maya, and Samir before merge.
